improvements.description: Replace the remaining `jq` canonicalization claim in the Audit Envelope Library dependency list with explicit RFC 8785 JCS tooling (`lib/jcs.sh`, `rfc8785`, `canonicalize`) and state that `jq` is non-canonical only.
improvements.rationale: The current line in §1.4.1 (`jq` as canonical-JSON dependency) contradicts the v1.4 JCS-only policy and can reintroduce signature/hash divergence in implementation.
improvements.location: §1.4.1 Shared Cross-Cutting Infrastructure → Audit Envelope Library → Dependencies

improvements.description: Unify the L4 trust-ledger canonical file path across the document (choose either `.run/trust-ledger.jsonl` or `grimoires/loa/trust-ledger.jsonl`) and update all diagrams, APIs, backup policy, and failure-mode text accordingly.
improvements.rationale: Conflicting storage paths create operational ambiguity for signing, backup, restore, and chain verification, risking data loss or false integrity failures.

improvements.description: Add an explicit two-stage validation contract for `audit_emit`: validate unsigned envelope fields first, then sign, then validate full signed envelope schema (or define separate pre-sign and post-sign schemas).
improvements.rationale: Current flow validates before signature while schema requires `signature` and `signing_key_id`, which is logically inconsistent and implementation-blocking.
improvements.location: §1.4.1 Audit Envelope responsibilities; §1.5.1 Audit Log Write Path; §3.2.1 envelope required fields

improvements.description: Standardize non-interactive configuration failure semantics by mapping `EX_CONFIG (78)` into the formal error taxonomy and exit-code matrix, including caller handling expectations.
improvements.rationale: The SDD currently uses both custom code `7` and POSIX `78` for configuration errors; inconsistent contracts can cause CI/cron misclassification and silent retries.

improvements.description: Correct the versioning statement that implies all State Zone files are git-tracked and align it with the explicit tracked/untracked matrix.
improvements.rationale: The current statement is factually inconsistent with `.run/*` untracked logs and can mislead recovery planning and audit retention assumptions.
improvements.location: §3.1 Storage Technology (“since all State Zone files are tracked”) vs §3.7 Persistence policy

improvements.description: Resolve the single-machine enforcement loophole by either including L3 writes in machine-fingerprint enforcement or documenting why L3 cross-host writes are safe under signature-chain and schedule semantics.
improvements.rationale: Current guardrails exempt L3 despite global single-machine scope; this creates policy inconsistency and potential cross-host drift for cycle logs.

improvements.description: Add concurrency-safe cache write semantics for L5 (temp-write+atomic-rename and optional lock per repo cache file).
improvements.rationale: L5 is labeled read-only/no flock, but it mutates cache files; concurrent invocations can produce torn JSON and stale/invalid cache reads.
improvements.location: §1.4.2 L5 responsibilities and dependencies; §3.6 Caching Strategy

improvements.description: Fix SLO reference drift by placing write-path latency targets in a dedicated section and updating all cross-references (including Sprint 1 benchmark acceptance criteria) to that exact section.
improvements.rationale: Current references point to §6.4 for SLOs, but §6.4 is logging strategy; this weakens acceptance-gate enforceability and review traceability.
improvements.location: Sprint 1 AC additions (SKP-004); §6.4; §7.1; changelog references to IMP-005
